pricing.seoDesc: View TranEasy's character-based and monthly subscription plans, and flexibly choose the translation and customer collaboration plan that best fits your team's stage of business.

pricing.faqDesc: Have questions? Look here — make every dollar you spend clear and transparent!
pricing.faqQ1: What exactly does 1.5 million characters mean? What happens if I run out?
pricing.faqA1:
• 1.5 million characters refers to the total volume of text processed by the translation engine (including both sent and received translations). For the vast majority of small and medium foreign trade businesses, this is typically enough for 6-12 months.
  • Running out: If you use up your character allowance, your account won't be frozen — the system will prompt you to purchase additional character packs at a very low unit price, or upgrade to a higher-tier plan, ensuring your business is never interrupted.
pricing.faqQ2: Why are the Pro and AI plans more expensive? Are they worth upgrading to?
pricing.faqA2: Higher-tier plans offer stronger translation capability, terminology-base matching, and smart assistance features, suited for teams with higher requirements for accuracy, efficiency, and complex business scenarios.
pricing.faqQ3: What are sub-accounts? Why should I choose a plan that supports them?
pricing.faqA3: Sub-accounts are designed for multi-person collaboration and permission allocation, letting a manager centrally oversee team members, data, and customer ownership, avoiding shared-account chaos during teamwork.
pricing.faqQ4: What's the difference between the Monthly (unlimited) plan and the Character plans?
pricing.faqA4:
• Character Plans (Recommended): Highly cost-effective, suited for everyday business communication, with data that's valid permanently.
  • Monthly Plan (Unlimited): Suited for users with a short-term burst of marketing needs. Note that the monthly plan has a time limit (30 days) and expires afterward, so please choose based on your actual business pace.

workOrder.ctaDesc: Say goodbye to customer-assignment chaos and achieve efficient collaborative service
workOrder.heroImageAlt: Traneasy Ticketing System and Traffic Routing Links Interface
workOrder.feat1Point1Desc: Customers come from all kinds of sources, and you have no idea which ad brought them in, making it impossible to calculate ROI.
workOrder.feat1Point2Desc: Generate a dedicated Traneasy short link for each ad group or video. When a customer clicks, the system automatically records the source information.
workOrder.feat2Point1Desc: Once a customer comes in, you still have to manually ask "where did you see us?" — wasting time and annoying the customer.
workOrder.feat2Point2Desc: The moment a customer starts a conversation, the system automatically tags them based on the link parameters (e.g., Facebook-Ad Group A), with no manual effort needed.
workOrder.feat3Point1Desc: Account contacts come from different countries, and you need to file contacts from the same country under the same account.
workOrder.feat3Point2Desc: Short links can be configured with interception rules that filter customers from different regions, so only contacts matching a region are routed into the corresponding account.
workOrder.feat4Point1Desc: In the past, issue handling had no record, no checkpoints, and no feedback — users couldn't know the progress, and managers struggled to track task advancement, creating severe information asymmetry.
workOrder.feat4Point2Desc: Supports self-service ticket creation, real-time display of full-dimensional ticket status, synchronized updates on handling progress, and full end-to-end visibility and control.
workOrder.feat5Point1Desc: Tracking employee attendance with no substantive reference data, so employees can't receive transparent, fair rewards or penalties.
workOrder.feat5Point2Desc: In the software backend, you can view the number of new contacts, new conversations, and conversion rates over the past 90 days by link/platform/ticket, making it easy to evaluate employee performance.
workOrder.cmp1Legacy: Customers reach out randomly, leading to uneven workloads from uneven assignment
workOrder.cmp1Traneasy: Link presets automatically assign customers to a designated agent or department
workOrder.cmp2Legacy: Customers have to repeatedly explain their issue, a poor experience
workOrder.cmp2Traneasy: Links carry built-in parameters that automatically identify customer source and intent
workOrder.cmp3Legacy: Inquiries, after-sales, and complaints all mixed together, chaotic management
workOrder.cmp3Traneasy: Automatic tag-based classification (e.g., pre-sale inquiry, after-sales complaint) for easy reporting
workOrder.cmp4Legacy: Requires manually asking "what issue are you experiencing?"
workOrder.cmp4Traneasy: Automatic system recognition lets support staff reply directly and specifically, shortening response time
workOrder.cmp5Legacy: No way to trace which ad brought in an inquiry
workOrder.cmp5Traneasy: Link parameters are passed back, precisely tracking ad conversion results
workOrder.sc1Desc: Use Traneasy traffic-routing links when running ads. View directly in the backend how many valid inquiries each ad group generated, precisely calculating ROI.
workOrder.sc2Desc: Pin a traffic-routing link in your video bio. When a customer clicks, they're automatically redirected to WhatsApp and tagged, letting you instantly know which video brought them in.
workOrder.sc3Desc: When multiple team members collaborate, the ticketing system ensures only one salesperson follows up with each customer, avoiding the awkwardness of two salespeople reaching out to the same customer at once.
workOrder.faq1Q: How do I generate a traffic-routing link?
workOrder.faq1A: In the "Ticket Management" section of the Traneasy backend, select the target account, enter the original link, set parameters and tags, and generate a dedicated short link with one click.
workOrder.faq2Q: Will customers see their source information?
workOrder.faq2A: No. All parameters run in the background — customers only see a normal inquiry link, with a smooth, seamless experience.
workOrder.faq3A: If you'd like to learn more about assignment rules, ticket field configuration, channel-recognition methods, or how to connect different ad platforms, feel free to contact our team for a more complete implementation plan.
workOrder.cta1: Supports multi-channel customer access, automatically generating a unique ticket number
workOrder.cta2: Smart routing rules, automatically assigning by region, business type, or support workload
workOrder.cta3: Real-time ticket status tracking — handling progress and the responsible owner are clear at a glance
workOrder.cta4: Automatic linking of customer chat history, avoiding repeated communication
workOrder.cta5: Multi-agent collaborative handling, seamless handoff for complex issues, boosting service efficiency

dataAnalysis.seoDesc: Turn scattered communication data into decisions that drive growth, with an employee performance dashboard, customer source tracking, and communication script analysis.
dataAnalysis.title: Data Analytics
dataAnalysis.subtitle: Review Your Business with Data and Drive Decisions with Charts — Stop Running Foreign Trade on Gut Feeling
dataAnalysis.desc: A built-in powerful data-analytics engine cleans and aggregates the communication and customer-behavior data scattered across various social apps, generating intuitive visual reports so you can see your business status "at a glance."
dataAnalysis.comparisonDesc: Leave behind "gut feeling" management and drive performance growth with data, making team performance and channel value clear at a glance.
dataAnalysis.faqDesc: Full-dimensional data insight, giving every business decision a solid foundation!
dataAnalysis.ctaDesc: Turn scattered communication data into a decision engine that drives growth
dataAnalysis.feat1Point1Desc: As the team grows, you can't tell who's slacking off and who's a top performer — performance reviews end up based purely on impressions.
dataAnalysis.feat1Point2Desc: Admin accounts can view detailed sub-account customer information and edit history, quantifying work performance with data for fair, evidence-based rewards and penalties.
dataAnalysis.feat2Point1Desc: Did a customer come from a Facebook ad, a Google search, or a TikTok video? Without clear channel ROI, ad budgets get spent haphazardly.
dataAnalysis.feat2Point2Desc: Combined with the ticketing system, precisely track each customer's source channel, clearly calculate customer acquisition cost, and optimize your ad spend strategy.
dataAnalysis.feat3Point1Desc: No idea which lines of script close deals and which ones drive customers away — experience can't be replicated.
dataAnalysis.feat3Point2Desc: Automatically generates relevant reply content based on messages you send, making it easier to respond to customers.
dataAnalysis.cmp1Legacy: Scored by impression, lacking quantitative metrics, hard to convince anyone
dataAnalysis.cmp1Traneasy: Real-time stats on volume handled, response time, and conversion rate — let the data speak
dataAnalysis.cmp2Legacy: Ad channel performance is unclear, budget allocation is a guessing game
dataAnalysis.cmp2Traneasy: Precisely tracks customer source, clearly calculating ROI for each channel
dataAnalysis.cmp3Legacy: Experience can't be retained, great scripts are hard to replicate
dataAnalysis.cmp3Traneasy: Analyzes high-conversion phrases and churn points, continuously refining communication strategy
dataAnalysis.cmp4Legacy: Data siloed across platforms, requiring manual export and merging
dataAnalysis.cmp4Traneasy: Automatic cross-platform data aggregation, generating visual reports
dataAnalysis.cmp5Legacy: Report-making takes days, missing the best window to act
dataAnalysis.cmp5Traneasy: Real-time data dashboard, keeping you on top of business dynamics for fast decisions
dataAnalysis.sc1Desc: Check the employee reception report each morning, coaching staff with slow response times; review the high-intent customer list and step in promptly to prevent lost deals.
dataAnalysis.sc2Desc: Compare weekly the number of customers and final sales generated by different ad groups. Cut ineffective channels and increase spend on high-converting ones, so every ad dollar counts.
dataAnalysis.sc3Desc: Analyze chat history from the last 100 closed deals to extract the most effective opening lines and closing scripts, then share them with the whole team to boost overall conversion.
dataAnalysis.faq1Q: Will data analytics leak customer privacy?
dataAnalysis.faq1A: No. Traneasy strictly follows data-security standards, and all data is stored encrypted. Only the main account with admin privileges can view reports, and you can configure the data-visibility scope for sub-accounts.
dataAnalysis.faq2A: Yes. You can export communication records, customer lists, and performance reports for any time period as Excel or CSV, making it easy for offline archiving or further analysis.
dataAnalysis.faq3A: Yes. Message-sending and receiving statistics sync at the millisecond level, so the reports you see in the backend are always the latest, real-time data.
dataAnalysis.faq4A: If you'd like to learn more about dimension configuration, report permissions, export methods, or team collaboration scenarios, feel free to contact our team for a more specific usage plan.
dataAnalysis.cta1: Supports full-platform data aggregation — leave behind inefficient manual Excel tallying
dataAnalysis.cta2: Real-time quantified employee performance — reception volume, response time, and conversion rate at a glance
dataAnalysis.cta3: Precisely track customer source channels, clearly calculating ad spend ROI
dataAnalysis.cta4: Analysis of high-frequency scripts and churn points, continuously optimizing your communication SOP
dataAnalysis.cta5: Visual data dashboard, keeping you on top of business dynamics for fast strategy adjustments
